summary: Updated libcap packages fix security vulnerabilities
details:
CVE-2026-4878. A flaw was found in libcap. A local unprivileged user can
exploit a Time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition in the
`cap_set_file()` function. This allows an attacker with write access to
a parent directory to redirect file capability updates to an
attacker-controlled file. By doing so, capabilities can be injected into
or stripped from unintended executables, leading to privilege
escalation.
